defect: the source launches a new request without waiting for the returned acknowledgement
rationale: The destination acknowledges req_toggle_a, but the source toggles it for every edge_a even when ack_s1_a shows an earlier request is still outstanding.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: The source toggles the request on every edge_a without waiting for the acknowledgement, so toggles can be lost or merged when clk_b is slower.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the request and acknowledgement toggle paths in separate clock domains, reduced the edge-propagation state, and exposed a self-contained top module.

mutation.description: Removed the source-side acknowledgement equality guard so every edge_a toggles req_toggle_a.
